name: synctone
title: Anonymous Tone-Tagged Messaging
description: Anonymous messaging where senders tag the intended tone of each message. Tones are revealed when the receiver opens the chat.
audience: Anyone who wants to communicate with more clarity. Useful for sensitive conversations, remote teams, or situations where tone is easily misread in text.
useCases: Create anonymous chats with human-readable codes (e.g., 'happy-tiger')
Share chat links via SMS, WhatsApp, email, or any app
Tag messages with up to 2 tones (happy, sad, serious, joking, sarcastic, sincere, or custom)
Tones revealed automatically when the receiver opens the chat
React with emojis, reply to messages, edit within 15 minutes
Push notifications across iOS, Android, and web

dataPrivacy.storage: Messages stored in cloud database for delivery. Identity is a random device ID — no email, phone, or account.
dataPrivacy.authentication: Anonymous. Random UUID generated on first launch, stored securely on device.
dataPrivacy.deletion: Uninstalling the app permanently deletes your identity. No recovery, no backdoors.
dataPrivacy.security: Row-level security policies. Anti-spam rate limiting and auto-flagging. Anonymous reporting for moderation.
dataPrivacy.thirdParty: Supabase for database and realtime. OneSignal for web push notifications.
